WynnExcavation Site A#000.src: Well, I figured it out soon after you got back. We possess the crystal, don't go looking for Wynn Excavation again, all is not what it seems. Take that as a friendly warning.
WynnExcavation Site A#000.dst: Eh, sen döndükten kısa süre sonra anladım. Kristal bizde, bir daha WynnKazı'nın peşine düşme, hiçbir şey göründüğü gibi değil. Bunu dostça bir uyarı say.

WynnExcavation Site A#003.src: One tablet complete! Return it to Vade. Oh, and don't read it!
WynnExcavation Site A#003.dst: Bir tablet tamam! Vade'ye geri götür. Ha, sakın okuma!
WynnExcavation Site A#003.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#004.src: A strange force pushes you back!
WynnExcavation Site A#004.dst: Garip bir güç seni geri itiyor!

WynnExcavation Site A#005.src: What are you still doing over here? Go finish your assignment! It's written in your content book.
WynnExcavation Site A#005.dst: Sen hâlâ burada ne yapıyorsun? Git işini bitir! İçerik kitabında yazıyor.

WynnExcavation Site A#007.src: Oh, hey kid. Wanna make some money?
WynnExcavation Site A#007.dst: Ah, selam evlat. Biraz para kazanmak ister misin?
WynnExcavation Site A#007.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#008.src: I need you to translate this ancient text.
WynnExcavation Site A#008.dst: Bu kadim metnin tercüme edilmesi lazım.
WynnExcavation Site A#008.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#009.src: Just run it down to the lab assistant, Tesha.
WynnExcavation Site A#009.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#010.src: I'd take it myself, but I'm far too important for grunt work! The lab is up there in the tent, and don't you dare damage the translation!
WynnExcavation Site A#010.dst: Kendim götürürdüm ama angarya için fazla önemliyim! Laboratuvar yukarıdaki çadırda, sakın tercümeye zarar vereyim deme!
WynnExcavation Site A#010.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#011.src: Bring the Ancient Writing to Tesha in the tents at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

WynnExcavation Site A#013.src: Oh yes, the tablet I was waiting for!
WynnExcavation Site A#013.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#015.src: Oh my! This is quite interesting..
WynnExcavation Site A#015.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#016.src: Here, let me finish this up...
WynnExcavation Site A#016.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#018.src: Return to Excavator Vade with the translated writing
WynnExcavation Site A#018.dst: Tercüme edilen yazıyla Kazıcı Vade'nin yanına dön

WynnExcavation Site A#020.src: Oh right, you're that kid I sent out!
WynnExcavation Site A#020.dst: Ha doğru, sen şu gönderdiğim çocuksun!
WynnExcavation Site A#020.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#021.src: Well do you have the translated text or not?
WynnExcavation Site A#021.dst: Eee, tercüme edilmiş metin sende mi, değil mi?
WynnExcavation Site A#021.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#022.src: You do! Brilliant! Let's take a look at that...
WynnExcavation Site A#022.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#023.src: "Throw tribute an item to the wood that stands out, the right angle will open the way"
WynnExcavation Site A#023.dst: "Göze batan ağaca haraç olarak bir eşya fırlat, doğru açı yolu açacak"
WynnExcavation Site A#023.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#024.src: I wonder if it is talking about inside the temple... Oh, uh, I forgot you were here. Stay out of this kid, it's grown up business!
WynnExcavation Site A#024.dst: Acaba tapınağın içinden mi bahsediyor... Ah, ıı, burada olduğunu unutmuşum. Sen bu işe karışma evlat, bu büyüklerin işi!
WynnExcavation Site A#024.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#025.src: Solve this riddle in the tomb: "Throw tribute an item to the wood that stands out, the right angle will open the way"
WynnExcavation Site A#025.dst: Mezardaki bilmeceyi çöz: "Göze batan ağaca haraç olarak bir eşya fırlat, doğru açı yolu açacak"

WynnExcavation Site A#027.src: Return and talk to Excavator Vade
WynnExcavation Site A#027.dst: Geri dön ve Kazıcı Vade ile konuş

WynnExcavation Site A#028.src: Hey kid, did you just come from the tomb?
WynnExcavation Site A#028.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#029.src: I knew I shouldn't have been so lazy and got someone else to do the leg work!
WynnExcavation Site A#029.dst: Bu kadar tembellik edip ayak işlerini başkasına yaptırmamam gerektiğini biliyordum!
WynnExcavation Site A#029.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#030.src: Gosh, I can't tell my boss about this, he'll have my head! Literally! Wynn Excavation is not a group you want to betray, they are more powerful than you will ever know.
WynnExcavation Site A#030.dst: Tanrım, bunu patronuma söyleyemem, kellemi alır! Gerçekten! WynnKazı ihanet etmek isteyeceğin bir grup değil, sandığından çok daha güçlüler.
WynnExcavation Site A#030.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#031.src: YOU'D BETTER NOT HAVE TAKEN ANYTHING! THAT IS OFFICIAL WYNNEXCAVATION PROPERTY!
WynnExcavation Site A#031.dst: SAKIN BİR ŞEY ALMIŞ OLMA! ORASI WYNNKAZI'NIN RESMİ MÜLKÜ!
WynnExcavation Site A#031.speaker: Excavator Vade
